## Summary

A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or algorithm.

## Motivation

Explain the problem or use case this solves and why it belongs in `clypto` (keeping in mind the project's zero-bloat core scope).

## Proposed Design

Describe the proposed API, parameters, or behavior, and reference any relevant papers or upstream implementations if proposing an algorithm.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any workarounds or alternative designs you have considered.
